items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I had Ailey Miller play like Jimmy Doon... On a low register.

ctx.x: South Rack Wall Street is partly Fidgety Feet.

And it's partly... Um... Um... Um... Panama. That last... Last chord. Why, They like to play Panama. I mean... That's why I wanted... One of the... When I had... I said one of these days I'm gonna write a tune... That's gonna represent this whole idea. Mm-hmm. So I had to put a little part of this... And the clarinet chords instead of playing... Playing a high society clarinet chords... You know, and... I... I had Ailey Miller play like Jimmy Doon... On a low register. You see? Mm-hmm. And when we wrote this...…
Well, how did Baby Dodge rate in those days? When you were down in New Orleans?
